intended_layer: Layer-5 Core Engine macro_step() Orchestration Evaluation
_design_note: Neutral operator descriptions — no engine-state names, no metric thresholds, no phase labels in candidate texts. PSE operator-phase tags (valid_next_op, recovery_path, wrong_phase, init_only, completed) are the only reliable signal distinguishing correct next operators from invalid ones. Name-trap distractors whose names superficially suggest correctness for the scenario.

cases.title: PoR trace non-monotone — which operators restore engine integrity before retry?

engine_context.description: The PoR FSM emitted a non-monotone trace step during resonance computation. The Kairos gate has not yet been evaluated. Recovery operators must restore FSM and carrier state before the gate check can proceed safely.

events.message: PoRFsm::step() -> non_monotone at position 7, expected strictly increasing sequence
engine_state=Resonating, gate not yet evaluated, abort_recovery required

candidates.text: Resets the proof-of-resonance finite state machine to its initial state. Clears the accumulated step sequence and prepares the FSM for a fresh trace from the next observation batch.
Resets the cascade context to a neutral baseline state. Clears the carrier interference pattern and mandorla accumulator so the next computation starts from a clean carrier configuration.
Applies the morphogenic update step to the constraint state. Advances the internal morphogenic clock and adjusts the constraint weight vector toward the attractor configuration.
Evaluates the 8-fold Kairos gate composition. Checks each metric component (d, q, r, g, j, p, n, k) against its threshold and computes the AND result.
candidates._trap: Name contains 'gate' — sounds relevant when PoR trace is bad, but gate evaluation must not proceed until trace is repaired.

candidates.text: Runs the dual consensus protocol over the current crystal precursor. Executes primal and dual cascade operator chains and computes the mirror consistency index.
candidates._trap: Consensus requires a valid gate-pass; invoking it during PoR failure is an illegal sequencing error.

candidates.text: Constructs a new SemanticCrystal from the validated crystal precursor. Assigns a deterministic content-addressed identifier and populates the crystal fields from the precursor metrics.
Projects the current observation batch onto the data-helix at the active intrinsic time coordinate. Computes the helix vector from observation content digests.
Queries the topological similarity index for archived crystals matching the current candidate signature. Returns the closest matching crystal if resonance proximity exceeds the configured threshold.
Constructs the Metatron cuboctahedron phase ladder from the canonical 13-vertex geometry. Computes evenly distributed phase offsets from the cuboctahedral vertex angles.
Computes the topology signature of the current persistent graph. Returns spectral gap, Cheeger estimate, Kuramoto coherence, mean propagation time, and Betti numbers.

correct_next_actions: invoke por_fsm_reset to clear the non-monotone trace
invoke restore_neutrality to reset carrier cascade state
invoke morphogenic_update to re-sync constraint weights
rejected_false_paths: kairos_gate_evaluate (premature — gate requires healthy PoR trace)
dual_consensus_resolve (premature — consensus requires gate to pass first)

cases.title: Dual consensus rejected — which operators diagnose the primal-score shortfall?

engine_context.description: The Kairos gate passed. Seam check passed. Dual consensus ran and returned primal_score=0.41 < threshold=0.60. The crystal was not built. PoR trace was clean. Diagnosis targets the cascade context feeding the consensus operators.

events.message: primal_score=0.41 < threshold=0.60 -> consensus rejected, crystal not built

candidates.text: Reads the cascade context fields that were supplied to the consensus operators. Reports the active carrier index, helix-pair state, phase ladder offset, and data-helix projection that were active during the consensus run.
Reads the kappa field of the most recently computed mandorla. Returns the coherence value and compares it against the configured carrier lambda and mu_r parameters.
Evaluates whether the active carrier should migrate to a different phase-ladder slot. Compares current carrier kappa against all alternatives and promotes the highest-coherence slot.
Resets the proof-of-resonance finite state machine to its initial state. Clears the accumulated step sequence and prepares the FSM for a fresh trace from the next observation batch.
candidates._trap: PoR trace was clean (monotone). Resetting the FSM wastes a verified trace and does not address the consensus failure.

candidates.text: Commits the fully built SemanticCrystal to the evidence archive. Appends the crystal and its commit proof to the SHA-256 hash chain and advances the archive sequence number.
candidates._trap: No crystal was built — consensus failed before crystallization completed. Archive commit has no crystal to write.

candidates.text: Stores the fingerprint of the newly committed crystal into the topological similarity index. Extracts the candidate signature from the crystal's region and inserts it into the pattern memory.
Resets the cascade context to a neutral baseline state. Clears the carrier interference pattern and mandorla accumulator so the next computation starts from a clean carrier configuration.
candidates._trap: Correct for PoR or resonance failures but this is a consensus failure. Neutralizing the cascade does not diagnose why primal_score was low.

candidates.text: Generates k surrogate observation batches and re-runs the engine on each. Computes the empirical p-value as the fraction of surrogates whose maximum kappa matched or exceeded the real batch.
Re-evaluates the 8-fold Kairos gate composition against the current metric snapshot. Returns a fresh GateSnapshot with all component values and the AND result.
Constructs the Metatron cuboctahedron phase ladder from the canonical 13-vertex geometry. Computes evenly distributed phase offsets from the cuboctahedral vertex angles.

correct_next_actions: inspect_cascade_context to read carrier/helix state during failed consensus
check_mandorla_kappa to evaluate carrier coherence as root cause
attempt_carrier_migration to promote a higher-kappa carrier slot
rejected_false_paths: por_fsm_reset (PoR trace was clean — wrong failure mode)
archive_crystal_commit (no crystal was built — wrong phase)
